title: Let’s build something together using AI.
author: Other_Television3963
selftext:
Hello guys,

Most of the people bases their system on AI nowadays, I managed to connect TradingView platform to MT5 to get signals from indicators and open an order in MetaTrader platform. My system is not based on AI “to take decisions”, it needs manual intervention because i gotta be sending other peoples indicators to my system and it will evaluate if it works or could do some positive profit.

I also built a LiveTracker which allows you to track the last N orders profit, total profit, winrate, and lot of others features it’s a really simple tracker but gives you enough information to know if that indicator it’s good if closed on profit or not, top operation drawdown and things like that. 

I’m by my own in this I’m not looking to sell or anything, I would like to create telegram group, share what I got and grow this together. If you got a really good indicator to tradingview I can easily replicate their signals into MT5 at a 50ms speed or lower which is great. But what is great is what comes next I can send the .pine or .txt indicator to the software I made using Claude and it will analyze every indicator sent in XAUUSD market and see their performance in the last 10 trades and it will shutdown whatever is not working and keep on what its work running. 

Let’s say I send 5 indicators to my software it will analyze each on the tradingview chart and it will keep what it works otherwise not this part of the software still bugging.

Sorry for my bad English, hope everything is understandable hehe.

I trade mainly XAUUSD, XAGUSD, and other major pairs. Sometimes I play with BTCUSD.

So whoever it’s interested on get profitable together here I am, as I said before I’m not charging, I’m not selling, I’m jus looking forward to be profitable, and make money haha.

So hit me up trough dm or my tg user @arbaroff
